**Finding: compliant (no redline).**

The Agreement contains no non-compete or field-of-use restriction binding Customer, so it satisfies the NONCOMPETE preferred position:

- **Article 3 (Appointment)** — no exclusivity, sole-source, or requirements commitment; it addresses only performance by M&I affiliates, third-party services, and Proper Instructions.
- **Article 2 (Term)** — renewal mechanics only.
- **Section 21.11 (Future Acquisitions)** — confirmed not a restriction. It expressly contemplates Customer opening branches, commencing other operations, acquiring Control of additional financial institutions, and undergoing a Change in Control; the operative provisions deal only with conversion scheduling, Expenses/Conversion Fees, and limits on *M&I's* service obligation. It does not restrain Customer's business activity.
- **Section 21.7(B)** and **Section 23.5** are the only use limitations on Customer, and both are scope-of-licence/no-resale terms confined to M&I's own Services and escrowed source code. They do not limit what businesses Customer may operate or what products it may buy or build, so they fall outside this rule (and would be reviewed, if at all, under licence-scope rules).
- The only "compet-" occurrence in the document is "court or arbitrator of competent jurisdiction" (Section 22.10).

No redline proposed, consistent with the instruction not to flag terms that do not bind us.
